title: Subject and theme
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:13Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: None of the bank points teaches the difference between a text's subject and its theme; they cover camera angles, social distance in images and technical word meanings, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Subject and theme
card: The subject is what a text is about, in a word or short phrase. Examples are friendship, a storm or moving to a new school.
The theme is the idea the text suggests about its subject. It is a full sentence, such as: Friendship can be tested when life changes.
A subject names a topic. A theme makes a claim about it. Many texts can share a subject and still suggest different themes.
To find a theme, name the subject first. Then ask what the text seems to say about it.
draft.remember: The subject is the topic. The theme is what the text suggests about that topic.

a.q: A story follows Ravi as he trains for months and finally finishes a school cross-country race. Which option is a theme of the story?
opts: Hard work and patience can lead to success
Ravi and the school cross-country race
A story about running and training
a.why: A theme is a full sentence that states an idea about the subject. The idea that hard work and patience can lead to success is a claim. The other options only name the topic, so they are subjects.
a.clue: A theme says something about the topic. It is more than a topic.

b.q: A short story shows Priya hiding a mistake from her class, then feeling worse each day until she tells the truth. Which option states the subject, not the theme?
opts: Hiding a mistake makes guilt grow
People feel better when they are honest
b.why: Honesty is a topic in a word, so it is the subject. The other three are full sentences that make a claim about honesty or guilt, so they are themes. The sentence about guilt is tempting because it names a topic, but it still says something about it.
b.clue: Look for the option that is only a topic, with no claim.

a.best: Hard work and patience can lead to success
